name: Mountaineering Boots
description: Insulated double boots with rigid soles designed for high-altitude climbing and crampon compatibility. These boots feature waterproof outer shells and removable inner liners for warmth in extreme cold.

name: Technical Crampons
description: 12-point steel crampons with aggressive front points for ice climbing and steep terrain. Features a step-in binding system compatible with mountaineering boots for secure attachment on vertical ice.

name: Ice Axe
description: Lightweight technical ice axe with a curved shaft and aggressive pick for self-arrest and ice climbing. The adze is designed for chopping steps and clearing ice from holds on mixed terrain.

name: Climbing Harness
description: Lightweight alpine harness with adjustable leg loops that fit over bulky clothing layers. Features multiple gear loops, a reinforced tie-in point, and quick-release buckles for easy on/off.

name: Climbing Helmet
description: Ultralight hybrid construction helmet providing protection from rockfall and impact during falls. Ventilated design with adjustable headband and clips for attaching a headlamp securely.

name: Locking Carabiners (Set of 4)
description: HMS pear-shaped locking carabiners made from hot-forged aluminum for maximum strength-to-weight ratio. Featuring auto-locking gates to prevent accidental opening during belaying and rappelling.

name: Dynamic Climbing Rope (60m)
description: Single-rated dynamic rope with dry treatment for water and ice resistance at altitude. Features excellent handling characteristics and high impact force rating for lead climbing on alpine routes.

name: 4-Season Expedition Tent
description: Geodesic dome tent rated for extreme conditions with reinforced poles and storm-worthy fabric. Designed to withstand high winds, heavy snow loads, and sub-zero temperatures at base camp and advanced camps.

name: Expedition Sleeping Bag (-40°C)
description: Premium 850-fill goose down sleeping bag rated to -40°C for high-altitude bivouacs. Features a contoured hood, draft collar, and full-length zipper baffle to eliminate cold spots.

name: 8000m Down Suit
description: One-piece expedition down suit filled with 800-fill water-resistant down for summit pushes above 7,000 meters. Integrates jacket, pants, and built-in gaiters with reinforced knees and seat.

name: Merino Base Layer Set
description: Midweight merino wool base layer top and bottom that regulate temperature and resist odor naturally. The fabric wicks moisture efficiently while providing warmth even when damp.

name: Expedition Gloves
description: Insulated mountaineering gloves with Gore-Tex shells and removable fleece liners for layering versatility. Pre-curved fingers reduce hand fatigue, and textured palms ensure a secure grip on ice tools.

name: High-Altitude Goggles
description: Dual-lens anti-fog goggles with UV400 protection and photochromic lenses that adapt to changing light. Wide field of view and helmet-compatible strap for use in blizzards and high-glare snow conditions.

name: Alpine Backpack (65L)
description: Technical mountaineering pack with a suspension system designed for heavy loads and ice axe attachments. Features a top-loading design with floating lid, hydration compatibility, and crampon pocket.

name: Carbon Fiber Trekking Poles
description: Ultralight collapsible trekking poles with ergonomic cork grips and carbide tips for all terrain. Three-section telescoping design packs down small and deploys quickly for glacier travel and approaches.

name: Rechargeable Headlamp (600 lumens)
description: High-output rechargeable headlamp with multiple beam modes and red-light preservation setting. Battery performs in temperatures as low as -30°C, critical for pre-dawn summit attempts.

name: Handheld GPS Navigator
description: Rugged satellite GPS device with preloaded topographic maps and barometric altimeter. Features waypoint tracking, route navigation, and SOS messaging via satellite network for remote expeditions.

name: Expedition First Aid Kit
description: Comprehensive medical kit tailored for high-altitude mountaineering with supplies for trauma, altitude sickness, and frostbite treatment. Includes prescription medications like dexamethasone and nifedipine for emergency AMS intervention.

name: Portable Water Purifier
description: Pump-action water purifier with ceramic and carbon filters that remove 99.99% of bacteria and protozoa. Essential for treating glacial meltwater and stream water at base camp and along approach routes.

name: Supplemental Oxygen System
description: Lightweight oxygen delivery system with regulator and mask designed for use above 7,500 meters. Each cylinder provides up to 8 hours of supplemental oxygen at a flow rate of 2 liters per minute.

name: Avalanche Transceiver
description: Digital three-antenna avalanche beacon with rapid search capability and marking function. Automatically switches to transmit mode when buried, with a range of 70 meters for efficient rescue operations.

name: Insulated Sleeping Pad
description: Closed-cell foam and inflatable hybrid sleeping pad with an R-value of 6.5 for insulation on snow and ice. Reflective thermal barrier prevents heat loss to the ground during high-altitude bivouacs.

name: Portable Stove & Fuel System
description: Liquid-fuel mountaineering stove that performs reliably at extreme altitudes and sub-zero temperatures. Compatible with multiple fuel types and includes a windscreen and heat reflector for efficient snow melting.

name: Satellite Communicator
description: Two-way satellite messenger with GPS tracking, weather forecasts, and emergency SOS function. Enables text communication from anywhere on Earth, providing a lifeline in areas beyond cell coverage.
